shared_elements: headdress or head covering on a figure
incised or relief bands across the surface
justification: Both depict human figures with head coverings and use low-relief linear bands and some circular/rosette-like motifs, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a single massive frontal figure whose body itself is the surface, with schematic discs and curved bands laid on chest and torso, whereas B shows small profile figures in repeated procession within registers flanking an architectural stair, in a far more naturalistic, detailed convention.
